text_block_list.name: Anime-Loving Kid
text_block_list.text:
I found another fun anime!
The main character is super kind and reminds me of Big Sis Miracle~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"For me? Really?
Hehe, then I'll definitely have to take a look."

text_block_list.name: Anime-Loving Kid
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's only 24 episodes, so you'll breeze right through it!!
Tell me what you think tomorrow!!
I'll be waiting! Promise!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle kept watching anime until morning,
and it seemed she didn't get much rest...
